articles.title: Nor'easter Slams Northeast, Flooding Streets and Grounding Flights
articles.summary: A powerful nor'easter flooded New York and New Jersey on Saturday, forcing states of emergency. Over 100,000 homes lost power, 2,400+ flights were delayed, and a full moon made the flooding worse.

articles.title: Trump Uses Rare 'Pocket Rescission' to Cut $1 Billion Congress Already Approved
articles.summary: President Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion in spending Congress approved, mostly for refugee services and diversity programs. A Republican senator calls it illegal. The Government Accountability Office agrees.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV Draws 600,000 to Paris's Champs-Élysées for Historic Mass
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV led a massive outdoor mass in Paris on Saturday, with more than 600,000 people registered to attend. The American pope rode his popemobile down the Champs-Élysées, drawing crowds of many faiths — and some controversy over the venue.
